notes: I run Mira's bakery and need a small website. Please build a home page with our story and opening hours, a menu page with up to 12 items, and a contact page with our address and phone number. The website must work on phones. I will supply the logo, copy, and product photos. We do not need online ordering or payments in this version. I might want a newsletter later, but haven't decided. I would like to launch next month. Can you send me an estimate?
